_meta.name: companion-relationship reference table
_meta.status: VERIFIED 2026-05-30 against published interior-design / ergonomics guidance; bands widened/tightened from the original seed where sources disagreed (see verified_against per entry). Numbers remain rules-of-thumb, not hard limits — tier stays advisory.

value_or_band_schema.basis: offset_from_ref  (acceptable related range = ref + [min,max])  |  absolute  (related compared directly to [min,max])

_meta.WARNING: This table is reference DATA only. The PIF-Trigamma grammar it presumes (part types, role fields, named dimensions like arm_height/top_height) DOES NOT EXIST in this repo. See docs/decisions/VALIDATION-OF-PIF-01-schema-read.md. None of the dimension names below resolve to a real schema field yet.

value_or_band.note: end-table top within ~2" above to ~4" below couch arm; 5"+ taller reads awkward

entries.verified_against: Widely cited rule: end table within 2" of sofa arm height; 3-4" below still looks intentional, 5"+ too tall is awkward. (rapportfurniture.com, ballarddesigns.com, eurekaergonomic.com). Seed was ±1" -> widened to -4..+2.

value_or_band.note: coffee top level with sofa seat cushion to ~2" below; >2" below forces awkward bending

entries.verified_against: Dominant rule: coffee table = sofa seat-cushion height or 1-2" lower; >~5cm/2" below strains the back (bobvila.com, roveconcepts.com, petramadalena.com). Seed was -4..0 -> tightened to -2..0.

value_or_band.note: legroom/reach gap between couch front and table edge; ~15" is the sweet spot, 12" absolute minimum, 18"+ for deep sofas

entries.verified_against: Confirmed: ideal 14-18" (35-45cm), 15" 'goldilocks', min 12" (2modern.com, apartmenttherapy.com, hernest.com). Seed 14-18 unchanged.

value_or_band.note: nightstand top level with mattress to +2" (tight 'safe zone'); broader tolerance -2 to +6" is still usable

entries.verified_against: Confirmed: top of nightstand level with mattress, +/-1-2" comfort margin; safe zone level to +2"; broad range mattress-top -2 to +6" (sicotas.com, julieblanner.com, froy.com). Seed 0..+2 kept as the tight band.

value_or_band.note: work surface 8-14" above seat (ideal ~10-12"); true target is elbows at ~90 deg, so this differential is a guide, not a hard rule

entries.verified_against: Desk 28-30" and seat 16-21" imply an 8-14" spread; ergonomics keys off elbow-at-90 not a fixed gap (omnicalculator.com desk-height, thehumansolution.com, urbanicafurniture.com). Seed 10-12 -> widened to 8-14 with 10-12 noted as ideal.

value_or_band.note: MINIMUM thigh clearance: seat sits at least ~7-7.5" below apron underside (95th-pct male thigh); band lower bound -14" is a chosen floor, not a sourced hard max

entries.verified_against: Confirmed: min 7-7.5" thigh clearance to apron underside (95th-pct male); derives from ~10-12" seat-to-tabletop minus ~4" apron (briansbenham.com, venturainteriors.com, woodworkersjournal.com). Seed >=7-9 kept; max offset set to -7 (>=7" clearance).
